value.note: verbatim: “(a) If any Domestic Restricted Subsidiary is required to Guarantee the Obligations pursuant to Section 6.01 , then the Borrower shall (i) concurrently with the incurrence of the Subsidiary Debt triggering such requirement, cause such Domestic Restricted Subsidiary to enter into a Guaranty... (b) If the Borrower or any Domestic Restricted Subsidiary is required to grant a Lien on any Principal Property to secure the Obligations pursuant to Section 6.02 (a “ Collateral Trigger Event ”), then the Borrower shall, and shall cause any such Domestic Restricted Subsidiary to... take such actions necessary to grant to the Administrative Agent for its benefit and the benefit of the Lenders a valid pari passu security interest”
